result.title: Fork separation + fresh multi-source ingest project

answers.answer: Merge latest upstream main into development first, then manifest

Preprocessing core (chunk/embed/ingest) (Recommended)
DB schema + alembic migrations (pgvector) (Recommended)
Corpus orchestration (_app corpus/scope/tracing) (Recommended)
Transcription + audio ingest path
Fact-check / SFL / assessment engine
Textual TUI + job queue
REST corpus/factcheck routes
MCP clause tools

Web URL → NotebookLM source (Recommended)
Raw text paste (Recommended)
File upload → NotebookLM source (Recommended)
Audio artifact → transcribe → ingest (Recommended)
Google Drive file
Notebook notes as input
Deep research import

The fork/upstream manifest exists under goals/fork-separation-ingest/, and the fresh project ingests all selected v1 source types end-to-end (add → fulltext → chunk → embed → pgvector) with passing automated tests.
